caption: The drawing depicts a detailed view of a wooden piece of furniture, specifically a small table or cabinet on four slender, turned legs with small caster wheels. A skirted, pleated fabric in a tan or light brown color encloses the lower portion of the piece, extending around its curved sides beneath the wooden top. In the lower left corner of the drawing, there is a smaller, black and white line illustration of the same piece of furniture, showing the same design features including the curved sides, drawers, and legs. title: Sewing Table
